definitions.explanation: The person who wrote a particular text, article, or book. Often used by writers to refer to themselves in the third person.

examples.japanese: {筆者|ひっしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{賛成|さんせい}→賛成：02829_sansei⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: I agree with the author's opinion.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{記事|きじ}→記事：00227_kiji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{筆者|ひっしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧⟦ですか→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: Who is the author of this article?

examples.japanese: {筆者|ひっしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦してきた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The author has researched this issue for many years.

notes:
USAGE: {筆者|ひっしゃ} is commonly used in academic and journalistic writing. Writers often use it to refer to themselves in the third person for a more objective tone.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {筆者|ひっしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧～ (the author/I [as writer])
- {筆者|ひっしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧/⟦{考|かんが}え→考え：00855_kangae⟧ (the author's opinion)
- {筆者|ひっしゃ}⟦によると→〜によると：03104_niyoruto⟧ (according to the author)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{著者|ちょしゃ}→著者：03501_chosha⟧ - author (of a book)
- ⟦{作者|さくしゃ}→作者：04169_sakusha⟧ - author, creator (of literary/artistic works)
- ⟦{記者|きしゃ}→記者：14170_kisha⟧ - journalist, reporter
- ⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧ - writer (professional novelist, etc.)

NOTE: {筆者|ひっしゃ} emphasizes the act of writing (⟦{筆|ふで}→筆：03601_fude⟧ = brush/pen), while ⟦{著者|ちょしゃ}→著者：03501_chosha⟧ emphasizes authorship of a published work.
